chunks: 5433 - It is narrated from Sulaym ibn Qays al-Hilali, who said:

I witnessed the وصيّة of ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام when he entrusted authority to his son al-Ḥasan, and made al-Ḥusayn, Muḥammad, all of his children, the leaders of his Ahl al-Bayt, and his Shiʿah witnesses to his وصيّة. Then he handed over to him the book and the weapon, then he said عليه السلام: “O my son, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله commanded me to bequeath to you and to hand over to you my books and my weapon, just as the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله bequeathed to me and handed over to me his books and his weapon; and he commanded me to instruct you that when death comes to you, you should hand it over to your brother al-Ḥusayn.” He said: then he turned to his son al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام and said: “And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله commanded you to hand it over to your son ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn.” Then he turned to his son ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام and said: “And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله commanded you to hand your وصيّة to your son Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, so convey to him salām from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and from me.” Then he turned to his son al-Ḥasan عليه السلام and said: “O my son, you are the guardian of the affair and the guardian of the blood. If you pardon, that is yours; and if you kill, then one blow in place of one blow, and do not sin.” Then he said: “Write:”

“In the Name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.” This is what ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib bequeathed: he testifies that there is no god but Allah alone, without partner, and that Muḥammad is His servant and His Messenger, whom He sent “with guidance and the religion of truth, that He may make it prevail over all religion, though the polytheists dislike it.” Then: “Indeed, my salat, my sacrifice, my life, and my death are for Allah, Lord of the worlds. He has no partner, and with that I have been commanded,” and I am of the Muslims.

Then I advise you, O Ḥasan, and all my children, my Ahl al-Bayt, and every believer whom my writing reaches, to have taqwa of Allah your Lord: “and do not die except while you are Muslims; and hold fast, all together, to the rope of Allah and do not become divided; and remember Allah’s blessing upon you when you were enemies and He joined your hearts together.” For I heard the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say: “Setting right mutual relations is better than the generality of salat and sawm.” Hatred is the shaver of religion, and corruption of mutual relations—“there is no power except through Allah.” Look to your kin, so maintain ties with them; Allah will make the reckoning easy for you. And Allah, Allah concerning orphans: do not leave their mouths hungry and do not let them be neglected in your presence. For I heard the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say: “Whoever supports an orphan until he becomes independent, Allah makes jannah obligatory for him, just as He has made the Fire obligatory for the consumer of an orphan’s wealth.”

And Allah, Allah concerning the Qur’an: let no one precede you in acting upon it. And Allah, Allah concerning your neighbors, for Allah and His Messenger gave instruction regarding them. And Allah, Allah concerning the House of your Lord: let it not be left empty of you as long as you remain, for if it is abandoned, you will not be granted respite. The least with which one returns who goes to it is that his past sins are forgiven. And Allah, Allah concerning salat, for it is the best deed and the pillar of your religion. And Allah, Allah concerning zakat, for it extinguishes the anger of your Lord. And Allah, Allah concerning fasting in the month of Ramadan, for its fasting is a shield from the Fire. And Allah, Allah concerning the poor and the needy, so share with them in your livelihood. And Allah, Allah concerning jihad “in the way of Allah with your wealth and your selves,” for only two men strive in the way of Allah: an Imam of guidance and one obedient to him, following his guidance.

And Allah, Allah concerning the progeny of your Prophet: do not let them be wronged among you while you are able to defend them. And Allah, Allah concerning the companions of your Prophet who did not introduce an innovation and did not shelter an innovator; for the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله gave instruction regarding them and cursed the innovator among them and others, and the one who shelters an innovator. And Allah, Allah concerning women and those whom your right hands possess. Do not fear, regarding Allah, the blame of any blamer; Allah will suffice you against whoever intends you and wrongs you. “Speak kindly to الناس,” as Allah, Mighty and Majestic, commanded you. Do not abandon enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong, lest Allah place the matter under the authority of the worst of you; then you will supplicate and it will not be answered for you. O my sons, hold yourselves to maintaining ties, mutual giving, and mutual goodness; and beware of cutting off, turning away, and division; and “cooperate in righteousness and taqwa, and do not cooperate in sin and aggression; and be wary of Allah; indeed Allah is severe in punishment.”

May Allah preserve you as a household, and preserve your Prophet among you. I entrust you to Allah and convey salām to you.” Then he continued saying, “There is no god but Allah,” until he was taken, may the prayers of Allah and His peace be upon him, on the first night of the last ten nights, the twenty-first night of the month of Ramadan, on the night of Friday, after forty years had passed since the Hijrah.

key_terms.بَيْتِ رَبِّكُمْ: the House of your Lord, i.e. the Kaʿbah
key_terms.بِتَقْوَى اللَّهِ: with God-consciousness and piety toward Allah
key_terms.صَلَاحُ ذَاتِ الْبَيْنِ: reconciliation and rectification of relationships between people
key_terms.وَلِيُّ الدَّمِ: the one entitled to decide regarding retaliation for bloodshed
key_terms.وَلِيُّ الْأَمْرِ: the guardian and holder of authority over the affair

ai.seo_question: What did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام say in his final وصيّة to Imam al-Ḥasan عليه السلام and his family?
ai.summary: This narration records the final وصيّة of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, including the transfer of the entrusted books and weapon through the line of the Imams and a broad counsel on tawhid, worship, social obligations, and communal integrity. It combines testamentary succession, Qur'anic citations, and ethical exhortations, ending with the report of his martyrdom in Ramadan.
